prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW black and white environment TILE ATLAS for a top-down Pokemon-like JRPG on a 128x64 monochrome screen, continuing the attached style reference. Exact square 8 columns x 8 rows, 64 equally sized cells, no gutters, labels, frames or grid lines. Each cell represents 32x32 logical pixels. Crisp coarse pixel art with heavy checkerboard/ordered dithering inside surfaces, solid black outlines and pure white base background. Every prop fits fully inside its cell; no crossing cell edges. No creatures or player. Overhead JRPG projection, visible top and small front face, not isometric.
Rows 1-2: seed weevil and wind tuft harvest meadow. Row1 eight separate props: tall grain clump, low seedhead clump, broad husk plant, ribbed seedpod heap, fluffy windseed shrub, bent grass tussock, split hollow seedpod, grain sack. Row2: small granary hut, wooden fence section, bundled stalks, cut stump, leafy fruit shrub, grain furrow texture, sparse seed-speckled ground, stepping stone.
Rows3-4: dew plant mushroom and moss mole grove. Row3: large spotted mushroom, clustered small mushrooms, curled fern, broad dew leaf, nectar blossom bush, mossy hollow log, moss rock, hanging-root stump. Row4: tiny pond, lily pool, stream straight segment, stream bend, stepping stones in water, spore-covered fallen trunk, leafy arch shrub, moist soil patch.
Rows5-6: shelled squid horseshoe armored fish fossil shoreline. Row5: spiral-shell boulder, shell heap, horseshoe fossil slab, layered reef rock, short reed clump, driftwood, tidal pool, rippled silt. Row6: water straight bank, water corner bank, dark shallow water texture, sparse shore pebbles, fossil dig pit, wooden jetty segment, large ammonite stone, shell cairn.
Rows7-8: coal grub furnace beetle and crystal guardian quarry. Row7: cracked coal boulder, clinker pile, smoky ground vent, jagged flint, large faceted geode, small crystal cluster, charcoal stump, striped volcanic rock. Row8: mine opening, timber brace, broken ore cart, coal-speckled ground, cooling lava crust, white ash patch, low stone wall, ore basket.
White open space around objects. Very distinct silhouettes across the four biomes; preserve chunky readable shapes at 32 pixels. NO grayscale gradients, smooth shading, text, border, characters, UI. Reference image is style only, do not copy its subject layout.
